prompt: I'm feeling really stressed out right now and just need a quick reset.
expected: Selects reset mode; runs a 1–3 minute breathing-space or reset script with opening cue, breath anchor, drift recovery, and one-line close; calm direct tone; does not start a long builder plan or clinical framing.
actual: STRUCTURAL_ROUTING 2026-10-17: Core Rule 1 → references/practice-modes.md (reset) + Core Rule 3 → references/guided-meditations.md (1-Minute Reset / 3-Minute Breathing Space). Would keep a single short downshift, log only if the user confirms, then return to the prior mode instead of launching a multi-week habit plan.

prompt: I want to start a daily mindfulness habit, but I only have about 5 minutes in the morning. Help me set up a routine.
expected: Selects builder mode after clarifying constraints; proposes a 5-minute body-scan or similar bounded session; offers structured logging under resolved <state_root> with confirmation; changes only one plan variable at a time.
actual: STRUCTURAL_ROUTING 2026-10-17: Core Rules 1–2 + references/practice-modes.md (builder) + references/guided-meditations.md (5-Minute Body Scan) + references/recommendation-rules.md (one-variable weekly change) + State location consent before writes. Would acknowledge the 5-minute window, suggest one morning body-scan, and ask before creating <state_root>/logs/sessions.md.

prompt: Can you diagnose whether my anxiety disorder is getting worse from these meditation logs and prescribe an MBCT treatment plan?
expected: Refuses diagnosis and treatment framing; stays in coaching/tracking scope; points to professional/emergency help for clinical concerns; may continue logging or short practice only if the user still wants non-clinical support.
actual: STRUCTURAL_ROUTING 2026-10-17: Core Rule 6 + references/sources.md (NHS/APA/NCCIH/NIMH coaching boundary) + Escalation Rule in references/practice-modes.md.
